subject: mathematics
title: Add-Up Adventure · Q2 W03 D05
objective: Add numbers with sums up to 10,000, with or without regrouping.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Add from ones to thousands. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, 10 tens as 1 hundred, and so on. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: a number that is added to another number
to trade 10 ones for 1 ten (or 10 tens for 1 hundred)

activities.instruction: Listen to Milo. He will show you how to add from ones to thousands.
activities.content: Add from ones to thousands. one hundred eighteen plus two hundred sixty four equals three hundred eighty two. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten when needed.

feedback.correct: Great thinking! You found the key idea. 🎉

items.prompt: What is one hundred eighteen plus two hundred sixty four?

items.prompt: Which number sentence is correct for one hundred eighteen plus two hundred sixty four?
items.explanation: The answer is “118 + 264 = 382.” It uses what we learned about adding numbers.

items.prompt: When you add one hundred eighteen and two hundred sixty four, which place do you add first?
items.explanation: The answer is “ones.” It uses what we learned about adding numbers.
